svg.aria-label: A terminal: the command is atlas-code; brew upgrade or atlas update moves an earlier atlas over and names the alias that keeps the short name

g.text: removed the earlier ~/.local/bin/atlas; to keep the short name: alias atlas=atlas-code
$ claude mcp add --scope user atlas -- atlas-code mcp
… the MCP server keeps its name, atlas; only the command it runs is atlas-code
